def toggle_middle_bits(n: int) -> int:
    """
    Toggle all bits of n except the first (most significant) and last (least significant) bit.
    """
    if n <= 1:
        return n

    # Number of bits needed to represent n
    bit_length = n.bit_length()

    # Mask with 1s in the middle positions only
    # Positions: 1 .. bit_length-2 (0-indexed from LSB)
    if bit_length <= 2:
        return n

    middle_mask = ((1 << (bit_length - 1)) - 1) & ~1
    return n ^ middle_mask
